name: @knowget/agent-orchestration
description: Enterprise AI Operating System, Agent Orchestration & Reasoning (P2-D26) — the AI runtime of the intelligence core (Program E), built on the semantic layer P2-D25 delivered. An agent registry declares what each agent is and what it is granted; a capability catalog is the only invocation surface an agent has, so agents invoke capabilities and never databases directly; execution plans are inspectable before they run (steps, dependencies, risk, reversibility); reasoning sessions record an auditable trace whose retrieval originates exclusively from the knowledge graph (P2-D25); tool invocation is permission-controlled and carries rollback (compensation) for anything not naturally reversible; and human approval is enforceable — a denied capability can never be approved into existence, and an approval-gated action cannot execute without one. Pure engines derive authorization decisions, plan inspection, compensation plans, reasoning grounding and operations metrics. External AI providers are reached only through the Phase-3 AI integration adapter (P3-D09) — nothing here calls a provider. Domain events carry ids, keys, statuses and counts only — no prompts, no reasoning text, no PII.
